data.name: The Night Orchard
data.subtitle: A seedship story
data.hint: Read the pump diagram and nursery manual. Prepare a cutting, investigate the reserve power, and weigh the specialists’ logs before spending the wake charge.
data.intro: The seedship's orchard is dying during its long voyage. Its sleeping crew cannot help until you decide which specialist to wake, and the last living tree needs a viable cutting first.

rooms.name: Night Orchard
rooms.description: A single pear tree grows beneath a failing artificial moon. A ship's caretaker terminal blinks among its roots.

rooms.name: Dry Cistern
rooms.description: Mineral crust rings the tank. A hand pump and a filter housing sit beside a maintenance diagram.

rooms.name: Seed Nursery
rooms.description: Empty trays line the shelves. A propagation manual lies beside a sterile grafting knife.

rooms.name: Sleeper Gallery
rooms.description: Two occupied pods wait below the wake console: botanist Sen and engineer Sol. Only one emergency wake charge remains.

actions.label: Ask the caretaker about the orchard
actions.text: The caretaker explains that saline water poisoned the roots. Filter the cistern, then use clean water to prepare a cutting in the nursery.
actions.journal: Filter the cistern and prepare a cutting in the nursery.

actions.label: Go to the cistern
actions.text: You follow a dry pipe to the tank.

actions.label: Set the manual nursery bypass
actions.text: You prepare a route from the hand pump through the filter housing to the sealed nursery. Once a filter is installed, the bypass can buy time if you keep pumping, but cannot repair the ship’s water system.
actions.journal: The manual bypass can sustain the nursery if someone keeps pumping; it is not a pump repair.

actions.label: Return to the orchard
actions.text: The tree rustles in the ventilation.

actions.label: Read the maintenance diagram
actions.text: The diagram shows a spare filter stored inside the pump's service hatch. Insert it before drawing water.
actions.journal: The spare filter is in the pump's service hatch.

actions.label: Test the tank and drain line
actions.text: A test strip turns violet: salt remains in the line. The diagram says to flush the first draw to the drain before collecting clean water.
actions.journal: Flush the salty first draw before collecting filtered water.

actions.label: Open the pump service hatch
actions.text: You retrieve the sealed clean filter.

actions.label: Filter and draw water
actions.text: You fit the desalination filter and flush the first salty water into a drain. Only then do you collect a filtered sample for the nursery.

actions.label: Go to the nursery
actions.text: You enter the quiet propagation room.

actions.label: Return to the orchard
actions.text: You return to the old tree.

actions.label: Read the propagation manual
actions.text: Cut a living shoot with a sterile knife. Soak it in filtered water; do not water the damaged roots with it.
actions.journal: A sterile cutting and filtered water make a viable graft.

actions.label: Take the sterile knife
actions.text: You take the sealed grafting knife.

actions.label: Take a living shoot
actions.text: You cut a green shoot above a healthy bud. The old tree still stands.

actions.label: Soak the cutting in filtered water
actions.text: The shoot drinks. Its buds uncurl in the nursery light.
actions.journal: A viable cutting is ready for a waking specialist.

actions.label: Inspect the caretaker’s reserve-power log
actions.text: The emergency reserve can run a sealed nursery for one watch, or power a wake cycle, but not both. A manually pumped bypass can deliver clean water without spending that reserve; the nursery lights and instruments remain on ordinary ship power.
actions.journal: The reserve powers either a wake cycle or one watch of nursery care; investigate the manual bypass in the cistern.

actions.label: Visit the sleeper gallery
actions.text: The wake console counts down its one remaining charge.

actions.label: Return to the orchard
actions.text: You leave the pods undisturbed.

actions.label: Read the specialists’ duty logs
actions.text: Sen can establish a graft and teach its care, but cannot rebuild the pump alone. Sol can repair the pump and keep the cutting safe, but is no botanist. Neither can do both jobs immediately.
actions.journal: Sen offers botanical expertise; Sol offers pump repair. The other job must wait.

actions.label: Wake botanist Sen
actions.text: Sen plants the cutting in a sealed nursery and promises to teach the next generation its care. The ship's failing pump will need a later repair.
actions.journal: Sen safeguards the tree's living heir.

actions.label: Keep both asleep and tend the nursery yourself
actions.text: You carry the cutting to the sealed nursery and begin the manual pumping watch. Ordinary ship power keeps the nursery lit. Both specialists remain asleep and the wake charge is preserved. The cutting has a chance, but its future depends on your continued care and the pump is still broken.
actions.journal: You keep both specialists asleep and tend the cutting by hand; neither graft nor pump repair is assured.

actions.label: Wake engineer Sol
actions.text: Sol secures the cutting in the nursery, then begins rebuilding the pump. The tree's graft will need patient attention from the next crew.
actions.journal: Sol protects the cutting and begins restoring the water system.

victory.title: A future takes root
victory.epilogue: The cutting has a chance beyond this night. Your choice and its unresolved cost remain below and in the journal.
